posts.text: During Q2 FY27, the company achieved its highest ever topline of ₹223 Cr (growth of 37% YoY) but EBITDA margins remained at 15% - there was no benefit of operating leverage. This is the likely reason markets didn’t give it a thumbs up in my view. Screenshot 2026-10-27 at 12.15.44 PM 3704×1184 396 KB There might have been some impact of the geopolitical situation on their EXIM biz so next couple of quarters are very crucial. posts.text: This quarters, results are also good, but still the stock took a hit. I am trying to understand, what could be the market expectations. The return ratios are not good, definitely bad but we also need to understand this is a turn around story. If anyone have any rationale, why the stock is takling a hit, Please let me know.
